An investigation has uncovered major questions surrounding voter deletion applications filed during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Delhi's Mustafabad.
Public records show hundreds of Form 7 applications were filed in the names of BJP-appointed Booth Level Agents (BLAs). However, many of those individuals told The Hindu that they never submitted the applications or were unaware forms had been filed using their names.
